meta.what: A derivation, not an upstream file: USGS's county_analysis.csv (2010 counties) keyed by current county FIPS by an exact state + county name match, plus Census-documented renames. A current county whose boundary Census lists as changed since 2010 gets no row (meta.excluded). Values as published.
meta.source: U.S. Geological Survey: Belair and others (2024), Slope-Relief Threshold Landslide Susceptibility Models for the United States and Puerto Rico
meta.published: 2024-08-22 (data release); ScienceBase sends the request time as Last-Modified, so the input is identified by its sha256

renamed.what: renamed Kusilvak Census Area (2015-07-01), new code
spelling changed to LaSalle Parish, same code
renamed Oglala Lakota County (2015-05-01), new code

excluded.why: Hoonah-Angoon Census Area, part taken for the new Petersburg Borough in 2013
